description: In a crowded city park on a hot sunny day, a young man in an olive polo shirt and shorts crouches on the grass and turns a metal key in a sprinkler valve in the ground, sending a strong jet of water sideways with a small rainbow in it. Behind him the picnic crowd scatters in every direction: two young women run holding a blanket over their heads, a man leaps over a hedge and runs past, and a dog runs along. More sprinklers spray near a gazebo, and the young man looks calmly up.

en.question: What is the crouching man doing?

es.answer: Está girando la llave de la válvula.
